sources.entry: Ideon - Project workspace built around an infinite canvas; embed GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and Forgejo repositories alongside notes, links, and tasks, with real-time collaboration. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that places Git repositories, notes, links, and tasks on a shared infinite canvas, with real-time collaboration.
summary.what_it_does: Ideon organizes project context spatially on an infinite canvas instead of in folders or tabs. Blocks can be placed anywhere, and the README says things placed close together are related. It can embed live GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and Forgejo repositories and issues directly on the canvas. Notes support Markdown and rendered Mermaid diagrams, and blocks can also hold images, links, and files. Multiple users can collaborate on a canvas in real time. A time-travel feature shows historical snapshots of the workspace, and a canvas can be synced to a Git repository with notes and structure stored as versioned files. The README says it is deployed with Docker Compose and uses PostgreSQL.
use_cases: organize project repositories and notes on a visual map
track design notes and tasks alongside code
embed GitHub or Forgejo issues in a project board
collaborate with a team on a shared whiteboard-style canvas
review how project decisions evolved using snapshots
version project notes in a Git repository
how_to_run: Clone the repository (or download docker-compose.yml directly)
Edit .env and set SECRET_KEY (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32) and any DB credentials to change
Open the dashboard at the address shown in the README (URL not given in the extracted text)
notable: Spatial infinite canvas instead of folder navigation
Live embeds of GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and Forgejo repositories and issues
Time-travel view of historical workspace snapshots
Syncs canvas structure and notes to a Git repository as versioned files
caveats: Requires Docker and Docker Compose and a PostgreSQL database for setup
AGPLv3 requires sharing modified source if deployed publicly
